# Tenant Health Model

The health hierarchy and the **SRE Agent's interpretation of health**. **Unknown is not healthy** - missing telemetry, stale data, missing owner, or missing diagnostic settings resolve to *Unknown/Risk* and must be closed out.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

## Health at a glance

Resource Health distribution (Unknown is not Healthy) and the ownership/tagging coverage that the health model depends on.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| summarize Count = count() by State = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| order by Count desc
content.title: Resource health mix
content.noDataMessage: No Resource Health data is flowing (provider returns 0 records). Health is Unknown, not Healthy - enable Resource Health / diagnostics.

content.query:
resources
| extend owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), team = tostring(tags['OwnerTeam']),
         app = tostring(tags['Application']), wl = tostring(tags['Workload'])
| summarize ['No owner'] = countif(isempty(owner) and isempty(team)),
            ['No app tag'] = countif(isempty(app) and isempty(wl))
| project Gap = 'No owner', Resources = ['No owner']
| union (resources
    | extend app = tostring(tags['Application']), wl = tostring(tags['Workload'])
    | summarize Resources = countif(isempty(app) and isempty(wl))
    | extend Gap = 'No app tag' | project Gap, Resources)
content.title: Health-model coverage gaps

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Tenant Health Model" and WorkbookPage == "Tenant Health Model"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

content.json:
## Health hierarchy

`Tenant -> Management Group -> Subscription -> Workload/Application -> User Journey -> Component -> Dependency -> Infrastructure Resource -> Network Path -> Data Store`

**States:** Healthy / Degraded / Unhealthy / **Unknown** (= risk). The agent rolls health up this hierarchy; any Unknown at a lower level propagates risk upward.

## Health rollup by scope

Resource Health distribution by subscription and by region. Large Unknown slices indicate telemetry gaps, not health.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Count = count() by Subscription, state
| order by Count desc
content.title: Health state by subscription

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| summarize Count = count() by location, state
| order by Count desc
content.title: Health state by region

content.json:
## Workloads without owner

Resources missing an `Owner`/`OwnerTeam` tag cannot be routed or paged - the agent treats them as Unknown and recommends ownership assignment.

content.query:
resources
| extend owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), team = tostring(tags['OwnerTeam'])
| where isempty(owner) and isempty(team)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize ResourcesWithoutOwner = count() by type, Subscription
| order by ResourcesWithoutOwner desc
| take 100
content.title: Resources missing owner tag

## Resources without application mapping

Resources with no `Application`/`Workload` tag cannot be rolled into a service view and weaken the health model.

content.query:
resources
| extend app = tostring(tags['Application']), workload = tostring(tags['Workload'])
| where isempty(app) and isempty(workload)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Count = count() by Subscription, type
| order by Count desc
| take 100
content.title: Resources missing application/workload tag

content.json:
## Resources without telemetry

No diagnostic settings or stale/absent heartbeat -> Unknown health. These drive the diagnostic-coverage recommendations in **Observability Quality & Cost**.

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, _ResourceId
| extend Status = iff(LastHeartbeat < ago(15m), 'Stale', 'Healthy')
| where Status == 'Stale'
| project Computer, _ResourceId, LastHeartbeat
| order by LastHeartbeat asc
content.title: Stale or missing heartbeat (last reported)

## Missing dependency mapping

Components without mapped dependencies hide failure paths. Application dependencies seen in telemetry vs the expected map reveal gaps.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Calls = count() by Target, DependencyType
| order by Calls desc
| take 50
content.title: Observed application dependencies

content.json:
## Synthetic test coverage

Availability (synthetic) test coverage and pass rate. Workloads without a synthetic test have no outside-in health signal.

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Runs = count(), SuccessRate = round(100.0*countif(Success==true)/count(),2) by Name
| order by SuccessRate asc
content.title: Availability test coverage

### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
